name: brighttest
description: Unified BrightScript test runner — write Rooibos specs once, run headless (default) or on-device with coverage.
author: Ramon Lobo

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.studio:dev: npm --prefix lib/studio/web install && npm --prefix lib/studio/web run dev
scripts.studio:build: npm --prefix lib/studio/web install && npm --prefix lib/studio/web run build

//overrides: Transitive security fixes not reachable through a direct dependency bump.
brace-expansion + ip-address come in under @ramonlobo/rooibos-roku. A fresh install already
resolves patched versions on its own (minimatch's ^1.1.7 and socks' ^10.x both admit them),
so these pins exist to make that guaranteed rather than incidental, and to stop `npm ci` from
reinstalling the stale versions this lockfile used to hold. postcss + dompurify are dev-only
(vitepress / mermaid). Do NOT run `npm audit fix` here: it 'fixes' the postman-request chain
by downgrading it to 2.88.1-postman.8-beta.1 and pulling back a critical form-data advisory.
